verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted, open-source inference engine and server. It does not keep user account data in a vendor-hosted service, so 'export all of my data and leave' is a SaaS data-portability axis that does not fit this kind of product. Its use of Hugging Face model formats and an OpenAI-compatible API relates to interoperability, not to exporting stored user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
